articles.title: IonQ Shares Are Climbing Thursday: What's Driving The Move?
articles.teaser: IonQ shares are climbing Thursday afternoon as traders keep leaning into speculation over potential U.S. government support for the quantum-computing space.
articles.body:
IonQ Inc (NYSE:IONQ) shares are climbing Thursday afternoon as traders keep leaning into speculation over potential U.S. government support for the quantum-computing space.

  • IonQ shares are powering higher. What’s behind IONQ gains?

What Is Driving IonQ’s Stock Momentum?

IonQ's upward momentum is riding a wave of sector-wide funding following a $2.013 billion injection of CHIPS and Science Act grants across nine quantum companies. The primary buzz for IonQ centers on growing speculation that it will be the next beneficiary of Washington’s tech push.

This massive federal funding package includes a $1 billion grant to IBM to launch Anderon, a standalone superconducting wafer foundry for quantum chip manufacturing. Additionally, industry peers like D-Wave, Rigetti and Infleqtion secured commitments of up to $100 million each.

These milestones are crucial for IonQ, as they establish a clear valuation benchmark and drive a powerful sympathy trade whenever capital rotates into the quantum sector.

Critical Levels To Watch For IONQ Stock

IonQ is extended versus its trend gauges, trading about 30.2% above its 20-day SMA ($52.79) and 44.5% above its 200-day SMA ($47.57), which tells you the rally has been fast and crowded. Even so, the longer-term backdrop still carries some scar tissue from the death cross in February (50-day SMA below the 200-day SMA), so bulls typically want to see strength persist long enough to fully "repair" that longer trend picture.

Momentum is the key near-term risk: RSI is 70.69, which is overbought and often signals the stock is getting stretched after a strong run. In plain English, RSI helps gauge whether buying pressure has become overheated enough that a pause or pullback becomes more likely—even if the bigger trend remains up.

From a levels standpoint, traders are likely watching nearby pivots rather than moving averages far below price after this run.

  • Key Resistance: $76.00 — a nearby round-number area where rebounds can stall
  • Key Support: $60.00 — a recent, nearby round-number zone where buyers previously stepped in

How IonQ Generates Revenue In Quantum Computing

IonQ sells access to several quantum computers of various qubit capacities and is working to develop more advanced systems with increasing computational capabilities. It makes that access available through cloud platforms and, for select customers, through its own cloud service—effectively a quantum-computing-as-a-service (QCaaS) model.

Beyond QCaaS, the company also generates revenue from consulting work (like co-developing algorithms) and from contracts to design, develop, and build specialized quantum computing systems with related services. That mix matters for the current narrative because any expansion in government-backed quantum initiatives could translate into more funding pathways, procurement opportunities, and strategic partnerships across the ecosystem.

IONQ Stock Price Activity On Thursday

IONQ Stock Price Activity: IonQ shares were up 5.46% at $68.97 at the time of publication on Thursday, according to Benzinga Pro data.
